subject: Evaluation playbook: kickoff alignment & weekly cadence
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@opsgenix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation playbook: kickoff alignment & weekly cadence

Hi Liam — great conversation today. Quick recap + proposed execution plan so we have a shared ledger: 

Summary of ask
- OpsGenix wants to validate Redwood for automated ticket classification + triage over a 4-week trial; primary success metric is >85% accuracy on priority tickets and <200ms median inference latency for the production-like batch.

Proposed evaluation playbook (high level)
1) Kickoff (Week 0): alignment on data access, success metrics, owners, and security checklist.
2) Week 1: ingest sample ticket corpus, baseline run, and initial model config.
3) Week 2: iteration on prompts/labels, run blind eval, collect precision/recall.
4) Week 3: performance tuning (batching, quantization), latency stress test.
5) Final readout (end of Week 4): joint review, handoff notes, and SOW/next steps if green.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood: Priyom (trial PM), Rishi (technical lead), Marissa (CS lead / SOW)
- OpsGenix: Liam (product sponsor), Evelyn (SRE / infra lead)

Immediate asks / next steps
- OpsGenix to confirm data access method (S3 read role / secure upload) and list of sample ticket IDs (1-200) — due Wed, Jan 20.
- Redwood to share evaluation matrix and draft SOW by end of day Tue, Jan 19 (attached).
- Schedule kickoff: propose Thu, Jan 21, 10:00am PT (30-45m).

Attachments: evaluation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB) — includes success criteria and measurement plan.

If that looks good I'll lock in the kickoff. Thanks again for the time.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com

From: Liam Turner <liam.turner@opsgenix.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Powell <evelyn.powell@opsgenix.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook: kickoff alignment & weekly cadence

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with how we like to run trials. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Data access: we'll provide a temporary S3 bucket and IAM role scoped to read-only for the 200-sample set. Our infra team will share the role ARN by EOD Tuesday (Jan 19).
- Success criteria: OpsGenix product stakeouts will consider 85% accuracy on high-priority labels non-negotiable; if we hit that plus latency targets, we move to an expanded pilot.
- Kickoff: Thu, Jan 21 10:00am PT works for Liam and Evelyn.

Couple of asks for Redwood before kickoff:
- Can you include a short section in the evaluation matrix that spells out the blind-eval protocol? We need to ensure our compliance folks can reproduce results.
- Any special network requirements for the SRE runbook? (e.g., IP allowlist)

I'll loop in our SRE alias so they can confirm the role/IP details. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Liam
Liam Turner
Director of Product | OpsGenix
liam.turner@opsgenix.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Turner <liam.turner@opsgenix.com>, Evelyn Powell <evelyn.powell@opsgenix.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook: kickoff alignment & weekly cadence

Thanks — those asks are clear. A few technical clarifications ahead of kickoff: 

1) Blind-eval protocol: we'll produce two datasets — labeled-train (70%) for tuning and a held-out blind-eval set (30%) with labels withheld from Redwood engineers. We'll provide the evaluation script and seed details so results are reproducible. I'll add a short appendix to the evaluation-matrix.
2) Network: OpsGenix S3 access via IAM role is ideal. If an allowlist is required we'll provide the minimal set of Redwood egress IPs; otherwise we can use a short-lived presigned upload flow.
3) Latency target: clarify that the 200ms is median P95 by-request time for the traffic profile provided. We'll run a stress test in Week 3 to validate p95 under a 2x expected arrival rate.

I'll prepare a 1-page tech runbook to attach to the kickoff invite — will share before Wed EOD.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@opsgenix.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Draft SOW + kickoff invite

Hi all — attaching the working SOW draft and the evaluation matrix with the blind-eval appendix included. Highlights: 
- Trial length: 28 days (Kickoff + 4 weeks of hands-on evaluation)
- Success gates: 85% precision on high-priority labels, median P95 latency <200ms, integration checklist completed by Week 2
- Deliverables: weekly status notes, final readout deck, and action items for production planning if green

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB), evaluation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

I'll send the calendar invite for Thu, Jan 21 — invite will include the tech runbook Rishi mentioned plus the Zoom link. Please review the SOW and flag any changes inline by EOD Friday.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Turner <liam.turner@opsgenix.com>, Evelyn Powell <evelyn.powell@opsgenix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, OpsGenix SRE <sre@opsgenix.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff confirmed + pre-kickoff checklist

Thanks everyone — invite is on the calendar for Thu, Jan 21 10:00am PT. Quick pre-kickoff checklist (please reply inline with status):

OpsGenix actions
- [DONE] S3 role ARN shared (sre@opsgenix.com)
- [ACTION] Sample ticket IDs: deliver 1-200 manifest (due Wed Jan 20)
- [ACTION] Any firewall allowlist needs (due Wed Jan 20)

Redwood actions
- [DONE] Evaluation matrix + blind-eval appendix (attached by Marissa)
- [DONE] Tech runbook (Rishi) attached to invite
- [ACTION] Confirm who will own weekly status emails and the final readout deck (Priyom to own weekly; Marissa to own readout)

Agenda for kickoff (30-45m)
- Introductions and roles (5m)
- Security/data access & infra checklist (10m)
- Evaluation matrix walk-through (10m)
- Timeline/milestones & weekly cadence (5-10m)
- Open Q&A + next steps (5m)

If there are no blockers I'll proceed with the runbook steps and set the weekly update template (short written status + 3 metrics: progress, accuracy, latency). Look forward to getting started.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
notes: Thread contains attachments: SOW and evaluation matrix; internal participants are limited to Redwood staff per agents.md guidance.
